observations: Two-door refrigerator with a freezer on top.
Door panels feature a dark wood-grain pattern.
LG logo is visible on the top right of the freezer door.
A horizontal handle is mounted on the lower refrigerator door.
The unit is standing on a tiled floor in an outdoor or semi-outdoor setting.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The unit may not cool or freeze properly.
risks.proof: A video showing the interior with frost on the freezer shelves or a thermometer reading.

risks.risk: The compressor or gas lines may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the unit running with the compressor sound audible.

risks.risk: The door seals (gaskets) may be torn or leaking air.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rubber seals around the doors.

risks.risk: The interior may be dirty, damaged, or missing shelves.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the interior of both the freezer and refrigerator compartments.

proof_requests: Video of the refrigerator running with sound of the compressor.
Photos of the interior of both the freezer and refrigerator.
Close-up photos of the door seals.
A photo of the manufacturer's rating plate showing the model number and energy consumption.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
